The Survey

Everything close, nothing crowded

Painavu isn't a remote plot on the edge of the map — it's the administrative headquarters of Idukki district. The land sits within a short drive of government institutions that took decades to build, and years of forest to grow around them.

Govt. Medical College, Idukki (Cheruthoni)≈ 5 km
Govt. Engineering College, Idukki≈ 5.5 km
Cheruthoni Town / Idukki Civil Station≈ 5–6 km
Vazhathoppu Colony & schools≈ 1.5 km
District Ayurveda Hospital≈ 750 m
Idukki & Cheruthoni Dams≈ 7 km
Kottayam Railway Station≈ 97 km
Cochin International Airport≈ 120 km

Distances approximate, based on the certified location plan and district records.

Painavu also hosts the Model Polytechnic College, Kendriya Vidyalaya, District Panchayath and Ekalavya Model Residential School — a rare density of institutions for a district otherwise defined by forest and hydro reservoirs.

Idukki district itself supplies roughly two-thirds of Kerala's hydroelectric power, and is known across the state as its spice garden — cardamom, pepper and coffee grow on the hills around this very plot.
